name: Tsubakiya Haruho
source:
A Special Investigator employed by the Metropolitan Police Department’s High-Tech Investigation Division.

She was an Art School university student, but was recruited to the division for her talent in deciphering the cognitive paintings outputted by the White Cube, an apparatus which produces graphical renderings of people’s thoughts.

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4822170/view/683017363938871435]Steam[/url]]

A Special Investigator employed by the Metropolitan Police Department’s High-Tech Investigation Division.

She was an Art School university student, but was recruited to the division for her talent in deciphering the cognitive paintings outputted by the White Cube, an apparatus which produces graphical renderings of people’s thoughts.
